title: SEBI proposes exit flexibility for Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs)
theme: SEBI proposes exit flexibility for Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs)
attentionJustification: Enforceable regulatory circular issued by RBI/SEBI/DICGC.

constituentArticles.title: SEBI proposes exit flexibility for Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs)
constituentArticles.text: SEBI proposed allowing AIFs to retain funds beyond permissible fund life for ongoing tax/litigation demands with 75% investor consent by value, capped at 3 years.

keyFacts: SEBI proposed allowing AIFs to retain funds beyond permissible fund life for ongoing tax/litigation demands with 75% investor consent by value, capped at 3 years.
